HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about National integration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say National integration never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat National integration as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing National integration.

8. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president

   C. Measure rainfall only

12. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
